judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), a spec file (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), and an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`), without actually implementing any of the production changes. `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` is completely untouched and `ajv` was not added to `package.json`, meaning all the newly added acceptance tests fail immediately. Furthermore, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) were performed, and the tests were placed in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` instead of the explicitly requested `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
